import matplotlib as mpl
from matplotlib.figure import Figure
from matplotlib.ticker import AutoMinorLocator, NullLocator
import pytest


@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["clear", "cla"])
def test_clear_discards_artists_and_restarts_color_cycle(method):
    with mpl.rc_context({"axes.prop_cycle": mpl.cycler(color=["red", "blue"])}):
        ax = Figure().add_subplot()
        line, = ax.plot([0, 1], [1, 2], label="line")
        ax.bar([0], [2])
        ax.scatter([1], [2])
        image = ax.imshow([[1, 2], [3, 4]])
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "annotation")
        ax.legend()
        ax.inset_axes([0.1, 0.1, 0.3, 0.3])
        ax._current_image = image
        assert ax.containers and ax.child_axes and ax.legend_ is not None

        getattr(ax, method)()

        assert not ax.lines
        assert not ax.patches
        assert not ax.collections
        assert not ax.images
        assert not ax.texts
        assert not ax.containers
        assert not ax.child_axes
        assert ax.legend_ is None
        assert ax._current_image is None
        assert ax._children == []
        assert ax.plot([0, 1], [1, 2])[0].get_color() == line.get_color()


def test_clear_resets_unshared_axis_properties_and_plot_state():
    ax = Figure().add_subplot()
    ax.set(xscale="log", yscale="log", xlim=(2, 20), ylim=(3, 30),
           xlabel="before x", ylabel="before y")
    ax.set_xticks([2, 10])
    ax.spines["left"].set_position(("outward", 12))
    ax.margins(x=0.25, y=0.35, tight=True)
    ax.use_sticky_edges = False
    ax.ignore_existing_data_limits = False
    ax.set_axis_off()
    ax.stale = False

    ax.clear()

    assert ax.get_xscale() == ax.get_yscale() == "linear"
    assert ax.get_xlim() == ax.get_ylim() == (0, 1)
    assert ax.get_xlabel() == ax.get_ylabel() == ""
    assert ax.spines["left"].get_position() == ("outward", 0)
    assert ax.margins() == (mpl.rcParams["axes.xmargin"],
                            mpl.rcParams["axes.ymargin"])
    assert ax._tight is None
    assert ax.use_sticky_edges
    assert ax.ignore_existing_data_limits
    assert ax.axison
    assert ax.stale


def test_clear_replaces_callback_registry_without_leaking_listeners():
    ax = Figure().add_subplot()
    old_calls = []
    new_calls = []
    old_registry = ax.callbacks
    old_registry.connect("xlim_changed", old_calls.append)

    ax.clear()
    assert ax.callbacks is not old_registry
    ax.callbacks.connect("xlim_changed", new_calls.append)
    ax.set_xlim(2, 3)

    assert old_calls == []
    assert new_calls == [ax]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("minor_x, minor_y", [(False, True), (True, False)])
def test_clear_applies_current_tick_and_grid_rcparams(minor_x, minor_y):
    ax = Figure().add_subplot()
    ax.minorticks_on()
    ax.grid(True, which="both", axis="both")

    with mpl.rc_context({"xtick.minor.visible": minor_x,
                         "ytick.minor.visible": minor_y,
                         "axes.grid": True,
                         "axes.grid.which": "major",
                         "axes.grid.axis": "x",
                         "axes.xmargin": 0.15,
                         "axes.ymargin": 0.25}):
        ax.clear()

        assert isinstance(ax.xaxis.get_minor_locator(),
                          AutoMinorLocator if minor_x else NullLocator)
        assert isinstance(ax.yaxis.get_minor_locator(),
                          AutoMinorLocator if minor_y else NullLocator)
        assert ax.xaxis._major_tick_kw["gridOn"]
        assert not ax.yaxis._major_tick_kw["gridOn"]
        assert not ax.xaxis._minor_tick_kw["gridOn"]
        assert not ax.yaxis._minor_tick_kw["gridOn"]
        assert ax.margins() == (0.15, 0.25)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("title_y, auto_title", [(None, True), (0.8, False)])
def test_clear_rebuilds_titles_and_patch_from_current_settings(title_y, auto_title):
    ax = Figure().add_subplot()
    old_patch = ax.patch
    old_title = ax.title
    ax.set_title("old title")
    ax.set_title("old left", loc="left")
    ax.set_title("old right", loc="right")
    ax.patch.set_visible(False)

    with mpl.rc_context({"axes.titley": title_y, "axes.titlesize": 18,
                         "axes.titleweight": "bold", "axes.titlepad": 13}):
        ax.clear()

        assert ax.patch is not old_patch
        assert ax.title is not old_title
        assert ax.patch.get_visible()
        assert ax.patch.get_edgecolor()[-1] == 0
        assert ax.patch.get_linewidth() == 0
        assert ax.xaxis.get_clip_box() is not None
        assert ax.yaxis.get_clip_box() is not None
        assert ax._autotitlepos is auto_title
        for location, x_pos in [("center", 0.5), ("left", 0), ("right", 1)]:
            title = ax._left_title if location == "left" else (
                ax._right_title if location == "right" else ax.title)
            assert ax.get_title(loc=location) == ""
            assert title.get_position() == (x_pos, 1 if title_y is None else title_y)
            assert title.get_fontsize() == 18
            assert title.get_fontweight() == "bold"
            assert title.axes is ax


@pytest.mark.parametrize("shared_axis", ["x", "y"])
def test_clear_preserves_shared_limits_and_hidden_shared_artists(shared_axis):
    fig = Figure()
    master = fig.add_subplot(211)
    slave = fig.add_subplot(212, **{f"share{shared_axis}": master})
    getattr(master, f"set_{shared_axis}lim")(2, 7)
    shared_artist = getattr(slave, f"{shared_axis}axis")
    shared_artist.set_visible(False)
    slave.patch.set_visible(False)
    slave.plot([3, 4], [3, 4])

    slave.clear()

    assert getattr(slave, f"get_{shared_axis}lim")() == (2, 7)
    assert getattr(master, f"get_{shared_axis}lim")() == (2, 7)
    assert getattr(slave, f"get_{'y' if shared_axis == 'x' else 'x'}lim")() == (0, 1)
    assert not shared_artist.get_visible()
    assert not slave.patch.get_visible()
    assert not slave.lines
